properties.notes: Mixed site to edge of town centre that consists of both brownfield and greenfield land. Currently part utilised for caravan storage. A number of constraints are identified but if these can be addressed then a residential development could be taken forward, likely to be in the medium-term. Brownfield in part (0.19ha) - indicative yield of around 5 dwellings appropriate for this parcel. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 2628) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 1.10ha. Redevelopment could potentially be progressed a s part of a group of adjacent sites (2040, 2628, 9136). Recently confirmed that redevelopment of the land is being considered and that a residential scheme is likely to be proposed in due course. Currently considered developable later in the plan period. Identified as an allocation in the Reg.19 Local Plan (submitted May 2019) and also in the Hexham Neighbourhood Plan.
